notes.subject: Long Drive: click to swing, arrow-key clubs, meter and panel by the ball, fanfare, sounds
notes.body:
- Mouse click on the view counts as a swing press (menus excluded); Up/Down picks the club (Up = longer)
- Arc meter and info panel sit either side of the ball at address; panel moves to the corner in flight
- Landing: bigger dust burst, bounce puffs, camera bump. Target: confetti, ring pulse, shake.
  Bullseye: fireworks and a BULLSEYE! banner
- Synth sounds: meter clicks, strike, whoosh, landing, bounces, target chimes, bullseye fanfare, bucket jingle
- Kit: SwingMeterView.placeAt() and visible

notes.subject: Long Drive: arc swing meter, targets and scoring, 12-club bag, wider fairway
notes.body:
- SwingMeterView: arc shape (default), like modern golf games; bar still available
- 12 clubs set by distance (Ryan's chart); launch speed solved from distance (speedFor), tunable per club
- 6 targets with rings; points = yards x ring bonus (miss x1 ... bullseye x3); 10-ball bucket; end screen
- Fairway 90 yds wide and runs behind the tee; higher camera; fewer yard markers
- Tests: every club within 3 yards of its chart distance, scoring, bucket

notes.subject: Long Drive Range checkpoint 1: swing meter, ball flight, range
notes.body:
- engine/physics (new): BallFlight (gravity, drag, curve, wind, bounce, roll on surfaces)
- input/SwingMeter and ui/SwingMeterView: classic 3-click swing
- games/long-drive: 3D range, Driver/Iron/Wedge calibrated to ~260/170/100 yds, wind, aim,
  dotted flight trail, landing ring, carry/total readout, longest drive saved, rules tests

Putt Party: a leaderboard per course
notes.body:
Each of the four courses (Seaside Classic, Pirate Cove, Cosmic Crater, Candy Carnival)
now has its own global leaderboard and its own personal best. The kit's Site gained
score.boards in game.json and site.board, so any game can split its leaderboard
(modes, courses, difficulties).

notes.subject: Ready Set Grow: tutorial, offered on first launch and skippable
notes.body:
- New players are asked once: Learn to play (2 minutes) or Skip, just play.
  How to play on the table brings it back; every step has Skip tutorial.
- 15 steps on the real table against a gentle Basil: Lucky Clover, Draw,
  planting (Tulip, instant Leaf), Fertilizer, Shovel, a harvest, rain.
  Only the move the bubble asks for goes through.

notes.subject: Graduate Putt Party pieces into the kit: RollingBall, Motion, walkDistance, Props 2D and Skins
notes.body:
- physics: RollingBall and RollCourse, a ball rolling top-down on a course of rails, posts,
  slopes, bowls, water, sand, sliding gates, spinners and a (moving) cup. Kit Explorer demo "roll".
- math/motion: slide, orbit and spin on a loop, with position and velocity at any time.
- nav: walkDistance, distance around walls for level-testing bots.
- art: Props 2D (bumper, barrel, planet, gumdrop; beam, ship's wheel, candy cane; striped doors)
  and Skins (one Look, a skin per world: defineSkins, pickColor).
Putt Party now uses all of them; its bot plays every course stroke for stroke the same.
Fix: candy-cane spinners no longer draw a stray bracket past one end.

notes.subject: Putt Party: course preview in the picker. Kit: optionsScreen preview
notes.body:
Picking a course now shows a live picture of one of its holes (moving pieces playing),
difficulty stars (Seaside Easy, Pirate and Candy Medium, Cosmic Hard), the course's style,
what you will meet (moving cups, bumpers, spinners, doors, water, hills, counted from the
holes) and your best. Kit: optionsScreen takes a `preview` that follows the picks, and a row
with an empty label hides it.

notes.subject: Putt Party: three new courses with moving targets, and a course picker
notes.body:
Pick a course after the title: Seaside Classic (the original nine), Pirate Cove (rolling
barrels, the ship's wheel, a cup adrift on a raft, a whirlpool), Cosmic Crater (orbiting moons
and cups, drifting asteroids, gravity wells, airlocks) and Candy Carnival (candy-cane
carousels, sliding gumdrops, a chocolate river). Every course is par 27 so all strokes share
the one leaderboard; each course keeps its own best. Holes can now have moving cups, moving
bumpers (slide or orbit) and spinning bars. ?course=pirate&hole=4 opens a practice round.

notes.subject: Putt Party: aim marker trails behind the ball
notes.body:
The dotted aim marker now sits behind the ball, pointing back toward where you pull,
and grows with power like a slingshot band. Controls are unchanged. The power meter
moved to the open side in front of the ball so the two never overlap.

notes.subject: Putt Party: nine holes of seaside mini golf
notes.body:
New game from idea #2. Pull back with the mouse (or aim with the arrows and hold Space) to putt
through rails, bumpers, a hillside, a pond, a bowl, a volcano and a windmill door. Score is total
strokes, lower is better; water costs a stroke and a hole is picked up after 6.
Adds the Boardwalk look (1960s seaside mini-golf park) and the Bungee and Fredoka fonts to the kit.
Practice any hole with ?hole=N (no score posted).

- Kit Explorer cards demo: Win cascade button

notes.subject: Sound starts off in every game: a gear button with Music and Sound effects switches
notes.body:
Kit: soundSettings (shared switches, both off by default, remembered across every game on the site) and SoundGear (the gear in the bottom-left corner that opens Settings). Sfx and Music obey the switches and put the gear on the page by themselves, so every game with sound gets it with no game code. The pause menu Settings screen shows the same two switches.
Games: the old M-key mutes in AstroRogue, Drone Combat, Treasure Tunnels, CrownLand and Hold'em now flip the shared Sound effects switch.
Rule: AGENTS.md rule 5, CLAUDE.md, /new-game, /from-gdd and the lab GDD build prompt all say sound starts off and only goes through Sfx and Music.

Word Gardens chunk 4: the garden home, greenhouse, tasks and key puzzle
notes.body:
Home is now Greenhouse Forecourt: 12 tasks on garden nodes (plants, builds, a
key door). Greenhouse with two pots and two paper pots, real-time grow timers,
fertilizer halving (finishes under 10 minutes), collect and deploy. Build and
key tasks finish on the next level; the key level is a special key puzzle that
opens the door. Save upgraded to version 4 with a paper pot item.

notes.subject: Word Gardens polish: flower wheel, shuffle animation, power-up tips, no dev tools switch
notes.body:
Petals are teardrop shapes round a seed-head middle that also shuffles. Shuffle
flies each letter through the middle to its new petal. Power-ups describe
themselves on hover. Kit: settingsScreen and PauseMenu take devTools: false
to leave the Dev tools switch out of Settings.

notes.subject: Word Gardens chunk 3: themed daily crosswords, stamp card, mystery prize
notes.body:
Crossword layout generator (clean crossings, size limit) and two years of
themed dailies from config/themes.txt. Crossing words share cells, and a word
whose letters all show fills by itself. Stamp card pays a prize per daily and a
card prize on the seventh stamp. Daily mystery prize: three boxes drawn by date,
shuffle, pick one, see the others. Save upgraded to version 3.

notes.subject: Word Gardens chunk 2: power-ups, resources, bonus jar payouts, Double Up
notes.body:
Magnifying Glass (pick a cell), Lantern (key word, then longest), Pinwheel
(pick a letter, shown everywhere), seeds and fertilizer hidden in board cells
and collected when their word fills, bonus jar with a weighted prize table,
results rewards with the Double Up toggle. Save upgraded to version 2 with a
starting stock. New icons: beans, test tube, cyclone, droplet.
